title: Rezoning to allow housing at 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would change the zoning map from an M1-1 manufacturing district to an M1-2A/R6A district with a Special Mixed Use District designation at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn. It would help enable a new six-story mixed-use building with 18 apartments, including five permanently income-restricted units, plus 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026, and a related zoning text change would create a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.
